subject: Minimum execution-surface identity required to separate GitHub-hosted CI from owner-target-host runtime evidence
project_observations: WP1207 workflow run 33311147892 is bound to head_sha fc550a0edb7032c1a7592e32e9aaa802f46a7133 and workflow path .github/workflows/wp1207-portable-release-transaction-ci.yml.
At that exact head, job deterministic-hostile-twin-transaction-core declares runs-on: ubuntu-latest.

The corresponding jobs API result for job 99256303130 reports labels=[ubuntu-latest], runner_name=GitHub Actions 1000051152, runner_group_name=GitHub Actions, run_attempt=1, the same head_sha, and executed steps ending in success.
Current owner authority separately defines clay-direct-dev as the intended Frankenstein-2.0 build/test/runtime sandbox and the self-hosted runner/VPS bridge as an authorized execution transport.

Therefore the successful hosted-CI run is not a failed target-host assignment; it is a successful execution of a different declared execution surface. Target-host credit remains zero unless a distinct clay-direct-dev execution subject is observed.

external_primary.source: GitHub Docs — Workflow syntax for GitHub Actions
external_primary.finding: jobs.<job_id>.runs-on defines the type/destination class of machine; labels/groups constrain eligible runners.

external_primary.source: GitHub Docs — REST API endpoints for workflow jobs
external_primary.finding: Workflow-job evidence exposes run/job identity, head_sha, run_attempt, steps, labels, runner_id/name and runner-group identity.
Self-hosted routing is based on matching runs-on labels/groups; online/idle matching runners are assigned, and failure to pick up within 60 seconds causes requeue.

hypothesis: Runtime promotion should bind both the intended execution-surface contract and the observed execution-surface identity. A success is admissible for target-runtime credit only if the observed surface satisfies the intended target contract at the same source/run attempt identity.
counterhypothesis: No new workflow-level architecture is required if GitHub-hosted CI is intentionally component-only and target-host execution already occurs through a separate bridge/tool path; in that case the missing primitive is only an explicit scope/subject admission contract that prevents cross-surface credit.
falsifier: Find an admitted current runtime receipt that can prove clay-direct-dev execution at exact source/artifact identity without binding any intended/observed execution-surface fields. If such a receipt remains unambiguous under replay, rerun, hosted-CI coexistence and route changes, the proposed surface-binding fields are redundant.

minimum_identity_candidate.admission_rule: INTENDED_TARGET_MATCHES_OBSERVED_SURFACE && EXACT_SOURCE_OR_ARTIFACT_MATCH && EXECUTION_OBSERVED; otherwise preserve evidence at its narrower scope and set target_runtime_credit_delta=0.

architecture_implication: Do not mutate the existing ubuntu-latest component-CI workflow merely to make its success look like target execution. Keep component CI and clay-direct-dev runtime subjects distinct; bind their scope explicitly at admission and require a separate exact target-host receipt for promotion.
trigger4_handoff: For WP1207, treat run 33311147892/job 99256303130 as hosted component CI only. The next target-runtime gate is a separate bridge/self-hosted clay-direct-dev execution of the bound predecessor/candidate artifacts with exact source/artifact and host/route identity captured; reject any cross-surface success substitution.
